composition_study: Use case: compositing. Assemble a new alternate Solace title image from these THREE already completed paintings. Input 1 is the original APPROVED BACKGROUND: keep the same landscape, town, thatched Hearth, dusk mountain sky, river, bridge, cyan falling star and tiny distant eastern Bloom hint. Do not redesign or repaint the settlement. Inputs 2 and 3 are the completed isolated characters: Briana Lumen and Jon Kith. Preserve their faces, hairstyles, smiles, clothes, colors and painted stylized miniature treatment closely; do not substitute new people. Pair BOTH in the TRUE NEAR FOREGROUND at the right side, Briana slightly left of Jon, together looking warmly back toward the viewer. Their bodies crop naturally at the bottom edge around upper thighs; their heads at about 48% canvas height, torso in lower right. Their visible pair occupies the rightmost 40 percent, with figures at similar adult scale, Jon only slightly taller. This clear foreground framing explains their large apparent size: town is far behind them, NOT tiny houses beside their feet. No feet anywhere in the town, no giant standing on a village path. Keep the distant town broadly visible through the center with warm Hearth glow and the sky above them. Briana pale gold/cyan blonde, Jon rust-orange/cream/moss dark curly hair and beard, left arm geometric tattoo. Match cool dusk rimlight and warm reflected firelight without altering costume identities. Keep ALL of the LEFT THIRD DARK AND EMPTY for the menu, no figures there. Landscape 16:10 same as original, no words, no UI, no watermark. Final should read as a foreground Kith/Lumen character pair with a separate scenic town backdrop, not a map-scale illustration with giant inhabitants.
foreground_extraction: Background extraction only. Input 1 contains the finished foreground pair Briana (blonde adult woman pale gold/cyan) and Jon (adult man dark curls beard orange/cream/moss), with town behind. Remove absolutely ALL landscape, mountains, sky, star, buildings, trees, river and Bloom. Keep ONLY the TWO completed foreground characters together, preserving their faces, poses, clothing, tattoo, lighting, expressions, spacing, their overlapping relationship and bottom-edge cropping. Genuine transparent background, including all gaps between hair/arms/cloth; clean soft hair alpha edges, no residual background haze or brown/orange glow. Do not redesign either person. Do not add legs or extend bodies below crop. Keep their relative positions and framing; output a transparent paired foreground layer, not a new painting or complete title. No words, no scenery.
final_composition: Godot renders original background plus generated transparent foreground as separate textures. compose.gd and layers.json preserve the layout; no painting source is rewritten.
